metadata.buildMode: node --import tsx source driver; pre-existing compiled engine and projection; source shared reducer
metadata.buildTimeMeaning: oldest/newest filesystem mtimes, not a claimed reproducible build timestamp
metadata.environment: Concurrent repository agents, lint/refactor and build activity are not isolated; no existing app/session is touched
metadata.boundary: Synthetic actor runtime event ports; real driver, engine, in-memory journal, publisher, wire encoder/assembler and shared reducer; no provider or network socket
metadata.journalRetention: Full real InMemoryJournalStore events retained; their event count/JSON bytes and heap cost are included. Publisher retains the production 2000-entry delta window.
metadata.ordinaryActivityDefinition: Same kind/request/completed/tool count signature; changed signature classified separately as boundary activity
metadata.sourceTime: Date.now/new Date at actual emission, preserved by journal envelope and activity; no virtual clock
metadata.inputScheduling: One real 50ms batch loops over independent actors; overdue batches always yield; achieved rate is measured, not asserted
metadata.sourceModuleFreeze: Each worker caches modules after import. Disk-directory fingerprints do not prove exact bytes of all loaded transitive modules
metadata.measurementOverheadIncluded: CPU includes journal cloning, projection JSON byte counting, publisher retention, encode/assemble, schema validation, client reducer and sampling
metadata.resourceWindow: resources/measuredCounts/projectionWindow cover post-warmup; counts/projection/cleanup cover setup through termination; peaks are sampled
metadata.transportFlush: continuous >=30ms, replayable >=150ms checked by 50ms source tick; timers may be late under load
